designSystem.description: Use this design system in every screen. All shared components must look identical across pages.

themeModes.light: Light mode: main area bg ~98% light gray. Sidebar dark #0f1025. Accent: neutral slate (no blue) for primary buttons/links. Cards light or subtle. Status badges: light bg (e.g. blue-100, green-100).
themeModes.dark: Dark mode: main area bg ~10% dark. Sidebar #0f1025. Accent: blue #1337ec for primary buttons, active nav, highlights. Cards #151938. Status badges: dark bg (e.g. blue-900/30, green-900/30). Both modes must be designable — consider showing one or documenting both.

sharedComponents.sidebar: Left sidebar: dark #0f1025, fixed width ~240px. Logo at top, nav items (Dashboard, Leads, Contracts, Deals, Customers, etc.), icon + label. Active item: blue #1337ec accent (dark) or neutral (light). Collapsible to icon-only. Same on every authenticated page.
sharedComponents.header: Top header: search bar (placeholder 'Search leads, contacts, deals'), theme toggle (sun/moon), notifications bell, user avatar with dropdown. Same on all authenticated pages. Hidden on mobile (mobile header used instead).
sharedComponents.mobileHeader: Mobile: sticky header with hamburger menu (opens sidebar drawer), page title center, theme toggle right. Same on every page.
sharedComponents.breadcrumb: Breadcrumb: Dashboard > Section > Page. Same style on Leads, Deals, Contracts, Customers, Settings, Ad Agency. Uses muted-foreground for links.
sharedComponents.tabs: View tabs: Pipeline (grid icon), Table (list icon), Report (chart icon). Rounded toggle group. Active tab: accent color. Same on Leads, Deals, Contracts, Entity pages.
sharedComponents.entityToolbar: Toolbar above table/kanban: Filters (chips/inputs), Views dropdown, Sort dropdown, Save preferences, Reset, Column visibility, Clear filters. Rounded border card. Same on Leads, Deals, Contracts, Design Requests, Ad Agency tables.
sharedComponents.table: Data table: rounded card container. Sticky header. Columns: uppercase 12px bold labels, rows px-6 py-4. Avatar column, status badges (colored pills with dot), actions dropdown. Pagination in footer when needed. Same for Leads, Customers, Products, Suppliers, Items, Members.
sharedComponents.kanban: Kanban board: dark columns #151938 (dark mode) or light (light mode). Horizontal scroll. Column: colored dot + uppercase label + count badge. Cards: same style — value prominent, grip handle, assignee avatar. Same Kanban for Leads, Deals, Contracts, Design Requests, Projects.
sharedComponents.emptyState: Empty state: dashed border, centered icon, title, subtitle, primary button (Add first) and/or secondary (Clear filters, Reset). Same on all list/kanban pages when no data.
sharedComponents.statusPill: Status pill: rounded-full, colored dot + label. Used in table cells and cards. Same styling for New, Contacted, Qualified, etc.
sharedComponents.buttons: Primary (accent): blue or neutral. Outline: border, ghost on hover. Ghost: text only. Same button variants everywhere.
sharedComponents.dialogs: Modal: overlay, rounded content, header, footer with Cancel + primary. Same for Add Lead, Rename View, all forms.
sharedComponents.cards: Cards: bg #151938 (dark) or light. Border white/10 or subtle. Rounded-xl. Same for stats, activity feed, detail sections.
sharedComponents.pagination: Pagination: prev/next, page numbers. Same footer style in all tables.
sharedComponents.loader: Loading: centered spinner (border, transparent segment). Same in all loading states.
sharedComponents.statsCards: Dashboard stat cards: value large, label small, optional trend. Same 4-card row. Same on main Dashboard and Ad Agency Dashboard.
sharedComponents.filtersBar: Filters: search input with icon, Select dropdowns (Status, Source, Assignee). Same pattern for LeadFilters, DealFilters, QuoteFilters, ProjectFilters, ClientFilters, TaskFilters, ItemFilters. Mobile: search in toolbar row, filters in Sheet drawer.
sharedComponents.commandPalette: Global search (Cmd+K): centered modal, search input, quick nav items (Dashboard, Leads, Deals, etc.), recent leads. Same styling whenever opened.
sharedComponents.sheet: Mobile drawer: slides from right (left for RTL). Used for filters, mobile sidebar. Same overlay and panel style.
sharedComponents.formInputs: Input, Label, Textarea, Select trigger, Checkbox, Switch. Same border, focus ring, rounded. Used in LeadDialog, DealDialog, CustomerDialog, Settings, all forms.
sharedComponents.columnVisibility: Dropdown with checkboxes: show/hide columns. Used in Ad Agency tables, EntityToolbar. Same trigger and list style.
sharedComponents.commentsTimeline: Activity/comments: scroll area, avatar, author name, timestamp, body text. Same in Lead Detail Activity tab. Timeline dots optional.
sharedComponents.pageHero: Page title (large) + subtitle. Same on Leads, Deals, Customers, Settings, etc. Hidden on mobile when breadcrumb shows title.
sharedComponents.skeleton: Loading shimmer: table row placeholders, card placeholders. Same animation and gray tones.
sharedComponents.modulePermissions: Checkbox grid for module access (Leads, Ad Agency). Used in Settings Members table. Same as column visibility checkbox style.
sharedComponents.avatar: Initials fallback: rounded, accent bg. Same in header, table cells, cards. Sizes: sm (table), md (cards), lg (header).
sharedComponents.scrollArea: Scrollable region with custom scrollbar. Same in comments, dropdowns, long lists.
sharedComponents.tooltip: Hover tooltip on icon buttons. Same delay, placement, styling.

designSystem.desktopPromptSuffix: Include the shared left sidebar and header. Consistent typography and spacing.
designSystem.mobilePromptSuffix: Mobile layout: hamburger header, full-width content. Sidebar as bottom sheet or slide-out drawer. Tables: horizontal scroll or stacked cards. Kanban: horizontal scroll columns.

pages.name: Hadarya CRM Login
pages.desktop: Login screen: split layout, left panel with email/password form and Sign in button, right panel with brand gradient (blue #1337ec). Clean typography. No sidebar (pre-auth).
pages.mobile: Login: stacked layout, logo top, form full-width, Sign in button. Right panel gradient below fold or as background.

pages.name: Hadarya CRM Dashboard
pages.desktop: Dashboard: 4 stat cards in a row (Revenue, Deals, Leads, Conversion), bar chart for pipeline, line chart for monthly revenue, activity feed with timeline. Use shared sidebar, shared card style.
pages.mobile: Dashboard mobile: stat cards 2x2 grid, charts stacked, activity feed below. Hamburger header. Same sidebar as drawer.

pages.name: Lead Management Kanban
pages.desktop: Lead pipeline Kanban: columns New, Contacted, Qualified, Proposal, Negotiation, Won, Lost. Use shared Kanban component. Cards: lead name, value, assignee avatar. Sort dropdown in toolbar.
pages.mobile: Leads Kanban mobile: horizontal scroll columns, same card design. Hamburger header. Toolbar with Sort stacked.

pages.name: Lead Management Table
pages.desktop: Leads table view: columns Name, Email, Phone, Status, Value, Assigned, Actions. Use shared table component. Search bar, filter chips, column visibility.
pages.mobile: Leads table mobile: horizontal scroll or card list. Same columns, responsive.

pages.name: Lead Detail Profile
pages.desktop: Lead detail: back button, name header, tabs (Overview, Quotes, Activity). Contact info card, timeline, quote summary cards. Shared sidebar.
pages.mobile: Lead detail mobile: same content stacked. Tabs as segmented control or dropdown.

pages.name: Deals Pipeline Kanban
pages.desktop: Deals Kanban: columns Quote Approved, In Production, Ready for Delivery, Shipped, Delivered, Cancelled. Same Kanban as Leads. Cards: amount, expected date.
pages.mobile: Deals Kanban mobile: same as Leads Kanban mobile layout.

pages.name: Contracts Kanban
pages.desktop: Contracts Kanban: columns Draft, Sent, Approved. Same Kanban design. Cards: client name, total.
pages.mobile: Contracts Kanban mobile: same Kanban mobile layout.

pages.name: Quote Approval
pages.desktop: Quote approval: header, quote summary card with line items, Approve (blue) and Reject buttons. Shared sidebar.
pages.mobile: Quote approval mobile: stacked, full-width buttons.

pages.name: Client Directory
pages.desktop: Client Directory: hero title, filter bar. Table with avatar, name, email, status badge, actions. Same table as Leads. Pagination.
pages.mobile: Customers mobile: table horizontal scroll or card list. Same columns.

pages.name: Products
pages.desktop: Products: tabs, search, table with name, SKU, price, category, actions. Same table component as Customers.
pages.mobile: Products mobile: same table mobile pattern.

pages.name: Suppliers
pages.desktop: Suppliers: table columns name, contact, products, status. Same table, filters, pagination.
pages.mobile: Suppliers mobile: same table mobile pattern.

pages.name: Design Requests Kanban
pages.desktop: Design pipeline Kanban: columns Pending, In Progress, Completed. Same Kanban design. Cards: request title, assignee.
pages.mobile: Design Kanban mobile: same Kanban mobile layout.

pages.name: Automations
pages.desktop: Automations: card list of rules (name, trigger, action, toggle). Add button. Shared sidebar.
pages.mobile: Automations mobile: stacked cards, same design.

pages.name: Settings and Team
pages.desktop: Settings: Team section, Members table (avatar, name, role, module checkboxes), Invite form. Same table component.
pages.mobile: Settings mobile: stacked sections, table scrollable.

pages.name: Ad Agency Dashboard
pages.desktop: Agency dashboard: same layout as main Dashboard. Stats, pipeline, activity. RTL-friendly. Shared sidebar.
pages.mobile: Agency dashboard mobile: same as main dashboard mobile.

pages.name: Ad Agency Clients
pages.desktop: Ad Agency client list: same as Client Directory. Same table component.
pages.mobile: Same as Customers mobile.

pages.name: Client Detail
pages.desktop: Client detail: same layout as Lead Detail. Tabs, cards.
pages.mobile: Same as Lead Detail mobile.

pages.name: Projects Kanban
pages.desktop: Projects Kanban: same Kanban as Leads. Project stage columns.
pages.mobile: Same Kanban mobile layout.

pages.name: Project Detail
pages.desktop: Project detail: same as Lead Detail. Tasks, deliverables, timeline.
pages.mobile: Same as Lead Detail mobile.

pages.name: Task Calendar
pages.desktop: Task calendar: monthly grid, task cards by date. Shared sidebar.
pages.mobile: Task calendar mobile: week view or list. Hamburger header.

pages.name: Items Table
pages.desktop: Items table: same table component as Products.
pages.mobile: Same table mobile pattern.

pages.name: 404 Not Found
pages.desktop: 404 page: logo, Page not found message, back button. Minimal. No sidebar.
pages.mobile: Same 404, centered.

pages.name: Add Lead Modal
pages.desktop: Modal overlay: form for new lead (name, email, phone, source, status). Cancel and Save. No sidebar (overlay).
pages.mobile: Modal full-screen on mobile: same form, bottom actions.
